QUOTE: `callers` is documented as "callers plus the writers it reads from", so a writer can appear in the list. ... A writer that shares a key with the subject is in the same list as a true caller. Filter on `edge_class` before counting.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says callers mixes direct calls with shared-key writers in one list, distinguished by `edge_class` which the consumer must filter on.
